senses.gloss: f. (preced.) the legal condition of a mamzer, bastardship.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:2:3">Y. Gitt. IV, beg. 45ᶜ</cite> <he>שלא תבוא לידי מ׳</he> in order to prevent cases of bastardship.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>בניה באין לידי מ׳</he> her children will be subjected to the restrictions of &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:21">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ</cite> top <he>מ׳ בנתים ואת וכ׳</he> the difference between the two opinions concerns bastardship, and you say so (that the several followers of the two opinions did not hesitate to intermarry)?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6:8">Y. Yeb. I, end, 3ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M01663"><he>ממזרית</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yoma 18b:3">Yoma 18ᵇ</cite> <he>וממלא … מ׳</he> and fills the world with cases of bastardship; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 617:1">Yalk. Lev. 617</cite>; (<cite ref="Yevamot 37b:3">Yeb. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ממזרין</he>; a. e.
